req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-011 requires PUT /tasks/{task_id} to return HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a known-existing task (id=1) can be updated successfully with HTTP 200, verifying the happy path and that the 404 branch is NOT triggered for valid ids; (2) a negative/EP case using a clearly non-existent id (id=9999) to confirm HTTP 404 is returned with the correct detail message; (3) a boundary case using id=21 (one beyond the highest seeded id=20) to confirm the off-by-one boundary also yields 404; (4) an additional boundary case using id=20 (the highest seeded id) to confirm it returns 200, distinguishing the boundary from the 404 side; (5) a negative case using id=0 (below minimum valid id) to confirm 404 is returned. Together these kill mutations on the status code constant (404 vs 200/422), the None-check in update_task, and off-by-one mutations on the id lookup.

tests.name: test_put_existing_task_returns_200
preconditions: Database is seeded with 20 tasks; task id=1 exists with title='Read chapter 5'
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send PUT /tasks/1 with JSON body {"title": "Read chapter 5 updated", "completed": true}
expected: Response JSON contains id=1 and updated title
trace: R-TASK-011: verifies the non-error path so that mutations flipping 404->200 or inverting the None-check are caught
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_task_returns_200():
    r = client.put("/tasks/1", json={"title": "Read chapter 5 updated", "completed": True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 1
    assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5 updated"
    assert body["completed"] == True

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_task_returns_404
preconditions: Database is seeded with 20 tasks; task id=9999 does not exist
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send PUT /tasks/9999 with JSON body {"title": "Ghost task", "completed": false}
trace: R-TASK-011: primary error pathway — non-existent task_id must yield exactly 404
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_nonexistent_task_returns_404():
    r = client.put("/tasks/9999", json={"title": "Ghost task", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 404
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert "9999" in body["detail"]
    assert "not found" in body["detail"].lower()
